One of the easiest quests in Rookgaard: enter the village sewers, get past a few {creature:Rat|Rats} and open a box half-hidden behind rubble to receive a {item:Combat Knife}.
You can do this quest even at level 1, but kill the {creature:Rat|Rats} one at a time.
Go to the **Rookgaard** sewer entrance and go down.
Follow the path **north** and then turn **west twice**. You will meet several {creature:Rat|Rats}: there are 3 or 4 guarding the crate. Kill them.
Minimap: yellow = ramp, green = ramp to the crate
The Rats are weak, but several at once can be dangerous for a level 1 character.
The quest crate is **partly hidden behind rubble**. Use it to receive the {item:Combat Knife}.
The crate half hidden behind the rubble
Go back the same way: pass the ramps again, head **east** and then **south** to the sewer entrance and go up to the village of Rookgaard.
